title: Aurora Leigh
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
description: "Aurora Leigh" by Elizabeth Barrett Browning is a verse novel published in 1856.
longDescription: Written in blank verse across nine books, it follows Aurora's journey from childhood in Florence to her struggles as a poet in London.

authorInfo.bio: Elizabeth Barrett Browning (1806–1861) wrote Aurora Leigh. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
